newsitem.title: UK: Saudi tells OPEC it pumped 8.008 mbpd in February.
newsitem.headline: Saudi tells OPEC it pumped 8.008 mbpd in February.

text.p: Saudi Arabia told OPEC it produced near its official output quota in February, pumping 8.008 million barrels per day (bpd), the OPEC news agency said on Thursday.
The UAE said its wellhead output in February was 2.252 million bpd, in advance of its 2.161 million quota, it said. But the UAE said its supply to the market was in line with the OPEC allocation.
Supply, as defined by OPEC, is calculated as domestic consumption, plus net export sales of crude and products, plus withdrawals of stocks held outside national boundaries.
Algeria said it pumped 797,000 bpd, compared to its 750,000 bpd quota. It said supply to the market was 783,000 bpd.
Qatar also said it was running over quota, pumping 402,000 bpd.
Venezuela said it produced 2.4 million bpd. A Reuters survey had the Latin American producer in February at 3.18 million.
